name: Yuuhi no Naka de Kimi wa
source:
You just went through a breakup with your high school sweetheart, so you chose to travel a bit to recover from the shock. You end up in a small seaside town.

There you meet new girls, and later on, to your surprise, your ex-girlfriend appears. Will you rekindle your lost love, or bet on a new one?

[translated from backcover text]
translation:
你刚刚与高中时代的恋人分手，于是选择旅行，试图从打击中恢复，最后来到一座海滨小镇。

你在那里结识了新的女孩，后来，前女友竟也意外现身。你会重燃逝去的爱情，还是选择一段新恋情？

[翻译自封底文字]
